categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in research, development, production, and sales of polystyrene (PS) high-molecular new materials. The main products are divided into two categories: General Purpose Polystyrene (GPPS) and High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS). GPPS is used in applications requiring transparency such as optical displays and lighting, while HIPS is used in applications requiring impact resistance such as household appliances and medical devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mature polystyrene production technology using a '1+4' reactor configuration for GPPS and '2+4' for HIPS, enabling multi-stage polymerization with precise temperature and pressure control. The company has developed strong formulation design capabilities with 13 core product formulations (including 2 invention patents and 2 pending invention patents), 9 proprietary technologies, and 30 utility model patents for equipment and process improvements. The company utilizes advanced devolatilization equipment and processes to control residual monomer content to low levels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major customers in household appliances (Midea, Haier, Changhong, Hisense), lighting manufacturers (Suzhou Sanxin), and trading companies. Products are applied in electronic appliances, optical displays, lighting, toys, daily plastic products, packaging, building materials, and medical devices. The company has established long-term relationships with large-scale customers and maintains a customer base primarily consisting of large and medium-sized enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in the Huizhou Daya Bay Petrochemical Industrial Zone in Guangdong Province, China. Sales are concentrated in South China (62.20% of revenue) and East China (37.00% of revenue), with minor presence in other regions (0.80%). The company has established a subsidiary, Jiangsu Zhuowei Chemical Co., Ltd., in Jiangyin, Jiangsu Province for trading operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the chemical supply chain, positioned between raw material suppliers (primarily Sinopec Shell Petrochemical) and downstream manufacturers. The company purchases styrene monomer as its primary raw material and converts it into polystyrene products for sale to downstream manufacturers and traders. The company benefits from a unique '隔墙供应' (wall-adjacent supply) arrangement with Sinopec Shell, enabling pipeline-based material transfer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing high-end, specialized polystyrene products with emphasis on optical-grade GPPS for displays and lighting, and high-impact HIPS for appliances. R&D priorities include: developing low-processing-temperature GPPS, high-gloss and low-temperature-impact HIPS, food-grade products with low residual monomer content, and applications in new energy vehicles, medical devices, and electronic components. The company invests approximately 3.97% of revenue in R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of polystyrene products to factory customers (40.51% of revenue) and trading companies (59.49% of revenue). Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the goods, which occurs either when customers self-collect products or when the company delivers products to customer-specified locations. The company employs both long-term contract purchasing and spot market purchasing strategies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to Zhuochuang Information, the company currently ranks second in South China with 300,000 tons annual production capacity. Upon completion of Phase III expansion in 2025, the company will rank first in South China and second nationally with 480,000 tons capacity. The company competes primarily on product quality, technical capabilities, and customer relationships rather than price, with significant competitive advantages in specialized high-end products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of RMB 2.209 billion (11.67% growth from 2023's RMB 1.979 billion) with net profit of RMB 53.24 million (down 4.57% from 2023's RMB 55.79 million). Total assets reached RMB 1.893 billion at year-end 2024. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2023. Operating cash flow improved significantly to RMB 88.32 million in 2024 from negative RMB 18.77 million in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) superior product quality with physical properties exceeding industry averages in transparency, yellowing resistance, bending strength, and softening temperature; (2) specialized formulations for specific applications (optical displays, lighting, appliances) developed through extensive R&D; (3) cost advantages from pipeline-based raw material supply and low-inventory procurement model; (4) strong customer relationships with major appliance manufacturers; (5) geographic advantages in the Daya Bay Petrochemical Zone enabling rapid delivery to South and East China markets; (6) technical barriers in specialized products creating high customer switching costs.
